pageDownloadComment: Which platform Play uses for pack updates: "modrinth" or "curseforge". Both blocks can be filled; only the selected one is used. Default: modrinth (no API key).

modrinth.comment: Active host. Paste projectId when Modrinth approves the pack. Slug guessed as sieged-empires — change if the live slug differs.

curseforge.comment: Unused while pageDownload is modrinth. Kept for optional later. API key via secrets.json if ever enabled.

azure.comment: Azure Entra app Application (client) ID. Required for production MS login. See README Microsoft Auth section. Until set, msmc uses its default public client where available.
